configuration.reference: autoarray.util.fnnls.fnnls_cholesky (dense-sign start), stored in the corpus

posthoc: POST-HOC, NOT PRE-REGISTERED: exploratory candidates added after the phase-1 deciding run (results/notes/linear_solver_accuracy_2026_09.md); inputs to the phase-2 fix, not a verdict. Anchors: fnnls, pdip_raw, pdip_raw_polish, pdip_raw_tol_jaxnnls

fnnls.description: Reference. NumPy fnnls with incremental Cholesky from the dense-sign start (P_initial = solve(Q, q) > 0), the NumPy path of reconstruction_positive_only_from with the warm-start memo off. Defines x_ref; its metrics are a self-check.

pdip_raw.description: Released default for linear-object-only (MGE) inversions: forward PDIP on the raw (Q, q) at data_scaled_solver_tol(q), cap 50; the library returns y = x / D and the reconstruction y * D, reproduced exactly. Extras: the backward-pass polish / relaxed-KKT status from raw_forward_backward_status (not timed).

pdip_raw_polish.description: Raw forward PDIP (data-scaled tol, cap 50), then at most RAW_BACKWARD_POLISH_MAX_ITER tight PDIP iterations on (Q_pc, q_pc) warm-started from the mapped iterate (y, s/D, z*D); the polished y is kept iff the polish converges and is finite with s, z > 0 — PyAutoArray#573's backward-pass rule, applied here to the FORWARD value. iterations = forward + polish.

pdip_raw_tol_jaxnnls.description: Raw forward PDIP at jaxnnls's absolute tolerance min(n eps 5e3, 1e-2) (solver_tol=None on the raw system), cap 50 — the tolerance that is unreachable on an unscaled system; expected to run to the cap.

pdip_raw_polish_cap20.description: POST-HOC (exploratory, not pre-registered). pdip_raw_polish with the polish capped at 20 PDIP iterations instead of RAW_BACKWARD_POLISH_MAX_ITER, same keep rule (converged, finite, s, z > 0). iterations = forward + polish.

pdip_raw_polish_cap50.description: POST-HOC (exploratory, not pre-registered). pdip_raw_polish with the polish capped at 50 PDIP iterations instead of RAW_BACKWARD_POLISH_MAX_ITER, same keep rule (converged, finite, s, z > 0). iterations = forward + polish.

pdip_raw_tol_jaxnnls_cap100.description: POST-HOC (exploratory, not pre-registered). pdip_raw_tol_jaxnnls (jaxnnls's absolute tolerance on the raw system) with max_iter=100 instead of 50 — what the tight tolerance costs in iterations when the cap no longer truncates it.

pdip_raw_tol_jaxnnls_cap200.description: POST-HOC (exploratory, not pre-registered). pdip_raw_tol_jaxnnls (jaxnnls's absolute tolerance on the raw system) with max_iter=200 instead of 50 — what the tight tolerance costs in iterations when the cap no longer truncates it.

pdip_raw_tol_1e-4.description: POST-HOC (exploratory, not pre-registered). Raw forward PDIP with the data-scaled tolerance at factor 1e-4 in place of DATA_SCALED_TOL_FACTOR, cap 50 — the replace-the-constant family, tightened past 1e-3.

pdip_raw_tol_1e-5.description: POST-HOC (exploratory, not pre-registered). Raw forward PDIP with the data-scaled tolerance at factor 1e-5 in place of DATA_SCALED_TOL_FACTOR, cap 50 — the replace-the-constant family, tightened past 1e-3.

pdip_raw_tol_1e-6.description: POST-HOC (exploratory, not pre-registered). Raw forward PDIP with the data-scaled tolerance at factor 1e-6 in place of DATA_SCALED_TOL_FACTOR, cap 50 — the replace-the-constant family, tightened past 1e-3.
